name: OSM Polish Offshore Wind Catalog Record
abstract: Representative catalog record for the 2026-10-27 OpenStreetMap GeoJSON snapshot of offshore wind infrastructure in the Polish Baltic. Profiles the SeaDOTs catalog-data-tabular record envelope while describing the source asset as GeoJSON and linking its source and wind-farm interpretation profiles.

sources.title: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0

examples.title: Polish Baltic offshore wind OSM snapshot catalog record
examples.description: Catalog metadata for the retrieved 2026-10-27 GeoJSON snapshot. The asset contains mixed OSM feature types (turbines/generators, substations, and mapped wind-farm areas); source feature properties preserve osm_type, osm_id, nested tags, and any relation members. This example does not convert the snapshot into tabular data or imply a temporal series.

title: OSM Polish Offshore Wind Catalog Record
description: 'Catalog record profile for a dated GeoJSON snapshot of OpenStreetMap
  features. The catalog record envelope reuses SeaDOTs catalog-data-tabular for shared
  catalog metadata; the referenced data asset remains GeoJSON and is not described
  as a CSV, table, or time series. Source-specific feature data are represented as
  GeoJSON features whose properties contain OSM identifiers and the original OSM tag
  map.

  '

type: object

- itemType
- properties
- assets
- links
